purpose: Localize the sole remaining Repair37 H4/Z21 shift failure by freezing the emitted Repair37 Nt128 total H4 source arrays and projected boundary data and varying only the number of internal two-stage Radau IIA substeps per frozen Nt128 interval.

frozen_inputs.Repair37_primary_active_mask_definition: freeze the Repair37 Nt128 scale arrays and the Repair37 threshold sqrt(eps)*S_ref

unchanged_contract.source_stage_interpolator: unchanged Repair07 PchipInterpolator on the frozen Nt128 source grid
unchanged_contract.canonical_operator: unchanged Repair07 GE06+GE07 plus frozen Repair11 Lambda operator
unchanged_contract.constraint_metric: unchanged Repair07 cancellation-safe shift backward error

only_varied_numerical_control.method: same frozen two-stage Radau IIA tableau

diagnostic_routes.RADAU_PROPAGATION_FLOOR_CONFIRMED: Factor 1 reproduces Repair37; factor 2 improves the frozen-active Linf with observed factor1-to-factor2 order >=2.5 and reaches <=1e-6; factor 4 does not regress above 1e-6. This licenses a separately preregistered higher-accuracy H4 reclosure but does not certify Z21.
diagnostic_routes.PROPAGATION_ACCURACY_DEPENDENCE_CONFIRME: Factor 1 reproduces Repair37 and finer internal propagation materially improves the frozen-active shift metric, but the strict third-order confirmation condition is not met. Further propagation diagnostics are required.
diagnostic_routes.PCHIP_OR_OTHER_FLOOR_REMAINS: Factor 1 reproduces Repair37 but Radau substepping does not materially remove the defect. The next localization target is the frozen PCHIP stage-source representation or another propagation-stage numerical component.
diagnostic_routes.IMPLEMENTATION_FAIL: Frozen input binding or factor-1 reproduction fails. Repair38 may be repaired without changing this preregistered diagnostic contract.
